# mimecast_dmarc_dkim_definition (Resource)

Manage one DKIM definition for a delegated DMARC Analyzer domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_dmarc_dkim_definition" "example" {
  domain_id   = mimecast_dmarc_delegated_domain.example.id
  selector    = "selector1"
  record_type = "cname"
  hostname    = "selector1._domainkey.provider.example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) Delegated managed-domain ID.
- `record_type` (String) DKIM record type.
- `selector` (String) DKIM selector.

### Optional

- `flags` (String) DKIM flags.
- `hostname` (String) CNAME target. Required for CNAME definitions.
- `notes` (String) DKIM definition notes.
- `public_key_data` (String) Public-key data for TXT definitions.
- `public_key_type` (String) Public-key type for TXT definitions.
- `service_type` (String) DKIM service type.
- `source_id` (String) Associated source ID.
- `version` (String) DKIM version. Required for TXT definitions.

### Read-Only

- `delegation_published` (Boolean) Whether the DNS delegation record is published.
- `delegation_record_name` (String) DNS delegation record name.
- `delegation_record_ttl` (Number) DNS delegation record TTL.
- `delegation_record_type` (String) DNS delegation record type.
- `delegation_record_values` (Set of String) DNS delegation record values.
- `id` (String) Composite domain ID and DKIM selector.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_dmarc_dkim_definition.example delegated-domain-id/selector
```
